title: MythBrowse compat ruleset, schema 1
description: Per-site compat rules (TOML files; this schema describes the parsed document). The browser enforces the same rules in crates/compat/src/rules.rs, plus trust rules by source: only built-in or signed remote rulesets may use hosts = ["*"], and only for kind = "polyfill" with css / js. Local rules' JS is never put in the all-sites bundle. Copyright (c) 2026 JustMyth / Tan Ming Jing. SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0.

version.description: Monotonic. A signed remote ruleset older than the last one accepted is refused (no rollback).

hostPattern.description: "*" = every web site; "example.com" = it and subdomains; "=example.com" = exactly; "*.example.com" = subdomains only. Lower-case ASCII (punycode), no scheme or port. mythbrowse.internal never matches.

pathPattern.description: Path glob starting with /, * matches any run of characters.

blockPattern.description: host/path glob without a scheme, e.g. cdn.example.com/js/legacy-*.js. The host part is a host pattern other than "*".

ua.description: Preset ("firefox", "chrome", "servo", "firefox-windows", "firefox-linux", "chrome-windows") or a printable-ASCII user-agent string, 10-512 chars. Overrides what the page's scripts see (navigator.userAgent / appVersion / platform); the HTTP header keeps the global ua_mode.

js.description: Function body; runs once per page in its own try block.

block.description: Subresource loads (not navigations) to cancel on matching pages.

fills.description: Polyfills: the missing-feature names (as the bootstrap reports them) this rule fills in.
